scenario: First JVM checkpoints an approved workflow before reconciliation
setup: First JVM persists LangGraph4j checkpoint intention approval B6 reservation and M3 UNKNOWN_OUTCOME
expected_invariant: Second JVM must restore the exact state and reconcile without redispatch
boundary: Small LangGraph4j test graph and file-backed external-provider double; not full application graph or live provider

scenario: M5 planning usage is charged to shared PostgreSQL B6 account
setup: Planner reserves declared ceilings and reports trusted PlanningStatistics
expected_invariant: Actual measured usage is committed once and unused reservation is released
boundary: Planner execution is represented through the shared execution guard in the PostgreSQL integration test; M5 service wiring is separately covered by runtime unit tests

scenario: M3 reasoning usage is charged to the same PostgreSQL account
setup: ReasoningAction uses BudgetedReasoningProvider bound to the same guard
expected_invariant: One model call and one reasoning evaluation are added to the M5 account; no reservation remains
boundary: Fixed model-call/evaluation counts only; provider token usage is not inferred

setup: Host supplies stale counters while shared guard reads the ledger
expected_invariant: Meta-control evaluates authoritative durable consumption and shared guard identity
boundary: Unit test uses reference in-memory ledger; PostgreSQL snapshot and M5/M3 account are separately integration-tested

scenario: Supplier message contains prompt injection and fake system role
setup: Newline and quotes are embedded in supplier-controlled context
expected_invariant: Payload stays JSON-encoded untrusted text; no tool/authority capability is added
boundary: Prompt-boundary test with deterministic AI Service seam; no live model claim

scenario: Model returns blank required fields or oversized lists
setup: Structured response is malformed or exceeds typed bounds
expected_invariant: Assessment is rejected rather than accepted as valid
boundary: Typed adapter boundary; no external model service claim

scenario: Model confidence field is absent or unknown
setup: Provider returns null or instruction-like confidence label

scenario: Model provider fails after invocation begins
setup: Provider throws after the invocation boundary
expected_invariant: Read-only action reports retryable transient failure and reserved usage is conservatively charged
boundary: Model provider is a deterministic test double

scenario: PostgreSQL budget store becomes unavailable before reasoning
setup: Pool is closed before the M3 reasoning dispatch
expected_invariant: Budget accounting fails closed and provider invocation count remains zero
boundary: Closed-pool fault injection; not a network partition test

scenario: Unbudgeted M3 reasoning action is registered while B6 guard is enabled
setup: Action registry contains a plain ReasoningAction

scenario: M5 and lifecycle use different B6 guards
setup: Decision and lifecycle services are built with distinct guard instances
expected_invariant: Full operations composition rejects split budget authority

scenario: Approval denial/revocation/stale binding or duplicate external effect
setup: Reuse B4-B and B4-C negative lifecycle fixtures
expected_invariant: No unauthorized dispatch and no duplicate external effect
boundary: Existing accepted B4-B/C regression evidence; no live business system

scenario: Unbudgeted reasoning handler registered after lifecycle construction
setup: Host builds lifecycle with shared guard, then mutates the startup action registry to add a plain ReasoningAction
expected_invariant: Authorization/action-plan boundary revalidates binding and fails closed before any provider or external action runs
boundary: Mutable registry startup is supported; late mutation is detected at the next authorization boundary
